newsitem.title: USA: Groupe AB files to offer up to 11.2 mln ADSs.
newsitem.headline: Groupe AB files to offer up to 11.2 mln ADSs.

text.p: Groupe AB SA, the largest independent producer of television programming in France, filed Thursday with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission for the initial public offering of up to 11.2 million American Depositary Shares.
The ADSs represent up to 5.6 million ordinary shares and will be offered at an estimated price of between $21 to $24, each, the company said.
Of the ordinary shares being offered, 3.92 million shares will be sold in the U.S. and Canada and 1.68 million outside the two counties in an international offering.

The offering includes 4.45 million shares being sold by Groupe AB and 1.15 million by three shareholders -- Claude Berda, chairman and chief executive; Marc Sillam, chief operating officer; and Denis Bortot, executive vice president.
Berda will control about 67.3 percent of the company's stock upon completion of the offering, Groupe AB said.
